review.notes: All 33 physical pages diffed against the OCR markdown with a normalized word-level alignment; every remaining delta was accounted for as figure-internal text embedded as images, LaTeX-equivalent math, or table reordering. Code fences are balanced (3 txt prompt chunks). Physical pages 1, 2, 4, 5, 12, 13, 14, 15, 20, 21 were rendered and visually read (full pages 4-5 at 120 dpi; footnote strips and table header at 200-400 dpi). Dominant defect: all eight numbered page-bottom footnote bodies plus the page-1 author footnote were dropped while their markers survive; restored after their anchor lines per the established pattern. Demo-box speaker labels (User:, Phi-4-Reasoning, Constraints:, Availability:, Adjacency list:) were demoted from spurious headings; the six black demo banners stay headings. The print's own misspellings (outputing, Sores, consistent the with) are preserved. Figure-internal axis labels on pp.1, 3, 17, 32-33 are correctly embedded as images, not defects.
